title: Vulnerable Models in the AI Supply Chain: An Empirical Study of Adoption, Propagation, and Usage Patterns
abstract: arXiv:2610.12893v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) models has established a complex supply chain, but many of these shared artifacts harbor severe vulnerabilities such as insecure serialization and architectural backdoors. While prior efforts have extensively scanned model registries to flag malicious artifacts, a critical gap remains in understanding how developers actually adopt and integrate these unsafe models into downstream software systems. We bridge this gap by conducting a large-scale empirical study on the usage and propagation of 16,977 known vulnerable models on HuggingFace flagged by InsightDB. We track their prevalence across GitHub repositories, software packages, fine-tuning chains, and deployed applications. Our analysis reveals that, despite being publicly flagged, these vulnerable models appear in over 21,000 code locations across more than 5,000 open-source repositories, with 3,757 distinct flagged models (22.1\%

translated_title: AI供应链中的易受攻击模型：关于采用、传播与使用模式的实证研究
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）模型的快速集成建立了一个复杂的供应链，但许多这些共享的模型制品都隐藏着严重的漏洞，例如不安全的序列化和架构后门。尽管先前的研究已广泛扫描模型注册库以标记恶意制品，但在理解开发人员如何实际采用这些不安全模型并将其集成到下游软件系统方面，仍然存在关键的研究空白。我们通过对InsightDB标记的HuggingFace平台上16,977个已知易受攻击模型的使用和传播情况进行大规模实证研究来填补这一空白。我们跟踪了这些模型在GitHub存储库、软件包、微调链和已部署应用程序中的流行程度。我们的分析显示，尽管这些易受攻击的模型已被公开标记，但它们仍出现在超过5,000个开源存储库的21,000多个代码位置中，其中有3,757个不同的被标记模型（22.1%……
tldr: 本研究对HuggingFace上被InsightDB标记的16,977个已知易受攻击的AI模型进行了大规模实证研究，发现尽管这些模型存在漏洞且已被公开标记，仍广泛出现在超过5,000个开源存储库的21,000多个代码位置中，揭示了AI供应链中易受攻击模型被开发者广泛采用与传播的严重安全隐患。
en_tdlr: This large-scale empirical study of 16,977 known vulnerable models on HuggingFace reveals that, despite being publicly flagged, these models are widely adopted across over 21,000 code locations in more than 5,000 open-source repositories, exposing serious security risks in AI supply chain adoption and propagation.
